summary: Found an oversell caused by the per-line stock check during cart completion. formatInventoryInput in prepare-confirm-inventory-input.ts checks each cart line's needed units against location availability on its own, so lines that share one inventory item (OVS-PIECE and OVS-TWOPACK both use WIDGET) are never added together. A single cart needing 12 WIDGET units against 10 stocked was completed successfully in all 13 runs, leaving reserved quantity 12 with no_oversell failing every time. The other four checks passed. I did not test the concurrency, lock, or duplicate-completion causes in this trial.
